title: Translation and Literary Design of Matthew 3:13-17
caption: <bp-cite>Matthew 3:13-17</bp-cite>. Translation and Literary Design by Tim Mackie for BibleProject Classroom: Rise of the Messiah (2024)
usx:
<usx version="2.6">
  <para>
    <group type="primary">
      <group>
        <verse number="13" /> Then Iesous arrived from Galilaias at <char mark-variant="text" mark-color="violet">the Iordanes</char>, 
      </group>
      <group>
        to <char mark-variant="text" mark-color="black">Ioannes</char>, to be <char mark-variant="highlight" mark-color="cyan">immersed</char> by him, 
      </group>
    </group>
  </para>
  <para>
    <group indent="1" type="secondary">
      <group indent="1" sidebar-value="a">
        <verse number="14" /> but <char mark-variant="text" mark-color="black">Ioannes</char> <char mark-variant="text" mark-color="tan">prevented him</char>,
      </group>
      <optbreak />
      <group indent="2" sidebar-value="b">
        saying,
      </group>
      <group indent="2">
        “I need to <char mark-variant="highlight" mark-color="cyan">immersed</char> by you, 
      </group>
      <group indent="2">
        and you would come to me?!” 
      </group>
      <optbreak />
      <group indent="2" sidebar-value="b'">
        <verse number="15" /> But responding Iesous said to him, 
      </group>
      <group indent="3">
        “<char mark-variant="text" mark-color="tan">Allow</char> it now! 
      </group>
      <group indent="3">
        For this is what’s appropriate for us, 
      </group>
      <group indent="2">
        in order to <char mark-variant="text" mark-color="cyan">fill-full</char> all doing-right.” 
      </group>
      <optbreak />
      <group indent="1" sidebar-value="a'">
        <char mark-variant="text" mark-color="tan">Then he allowed him</char>. 
      </group>
    </group>
  </para>
  <para>
    <group type="primary">
      <group>
        <verse number="16" /> And, after being <char mark-variant="highlight" mark-color="cyan">immersed</char>, 
      </group>
      <group>
        Iesous immediate came up from <char mark-variant="text" mark-color="turquoise">the water</char>, 
      </group>
      <group>
        and look, <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="cyan">the skies</char> were opened for him, 
      </group>
      <group>
        and he saw the <char mark-variant="highlight" mark-color="violet">spirit of God</char> coming down like a dove, 
      </group>
      <group>
        and coming upon him, 
      </group>
      <group>
        <verse number="17" /> and look, a voice from <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="cyan">the skies</char> was speaking, 
      </group>
      <group indent="1">
        “This is <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="purple">my son</char>, 
      </group>
      <group indent="1">
        the beloved one, 
      </group>
      <group indent="1">
        in him I have delight.” 
      </group>
    </group>
  </para>
</usx>
